_comment: Hand-authored build input for scripts/build_assets.py. Dev-only: not shipped, not read at runtime. The generated ui/pets/index.json is the runtime source of truth. ids 1-6 and 10-12 are retired procedural pets; PNG pets start at 20. id 25 is locally reserved, so repository evolutions use 30+.

pets.name: Cinderclaw
pets.evolution_design: an adolescent fire-cat evolution: slightly taller and more athletic, sharper cheek tufts, two small swept-back ember horns, a short flame ridge from forehead to shoulders, larger claws, and a stronger forked tail flame; still cute, warm, and recognizably the same companion

pets.name: Infernomane
pets.evolution_design: a majestic adult fire-cat evolution: powerful but friendly proportions, a controlled blazing mane around the head and shoulders, longer swept-back obsidian horns, confident amber eyes, ember-plated forelegs, and a broad torch-like tail flame; noble rather than fierce, unmistakably descended from the reference
